payload.comment: Architecture research stage is consistent and complete. All deterministic checks pass (deterministic_findings is empty). Key verifications: (1) Data profile is internally consistent: 28×28×3 RGB, 9 classes, split sizes (89996/10004/7180) match official PathMNIST, imbalance ratio 1.63×, channel stats (R 0.74/0.12, G 0.53/0.18, B 0.71/0.12) are coherent for H&E histology. (2) Architecture priorities (resnet18, residual_cnn, compact_transformer, tiny_cnn, vision_transformer) are appropriate for the 784-pixel, 90K-sample regime. (3) Parametrization recommendations (LR 1e-3 CNNs / 3e-4 transformers, AdamW, batch 256, 60-100 epochs with early stopping, class weighting for 1.63× imbalance, label smoothing 0.05-0.1) are well-calibrated and internally consistent. (4) Representation plan correctly uses train-only stats for standardization (anti-leakage), augmentation factor 4 (hflip/vflip/brightness) yielding augmented_train_size 359984 = 89996×4. (5) Transformer guidance is sound: compact_transformer preferred over ViT, conv tokenizer kernel-4/stride-4 → 49 tokens verified (28/4=7, 7×7=49), patch-size degeneracy risk (patch 16→1 token) correctly flagged with mitigation. (6) Risk register covers overfitting, token scarcity, class-imbalance interaction, normalization sensitivity, LR mismatch, and residual depth at 28×28 — all with reasonable mitigations. (7) Evidence sources (OpenReview, arXiv, Nature) are cited. Minor non-blocking notes: llm_model_digest is null (reproducibility), test-set class distribution not profiled (reasonable anti-leakage choice), brightness augmentation on H&E warrants conservative range verification, and the analysis text appears truncated. None of these constitute deterministic findings. No action required beyond proceeding to the next stage.
llm_issues: llm_model_digest is null across all stages; the exact qwen3.8 checkpoint is not pinned, weakening reproducibility for LLM-assisted steps (non-blocking).

Test-set class distribution was not profiled (test_imbalance_ratio=1.0, test_to_train_prevalence_ratio=[] are placeholders); this is a reasonable anti-leakage design choice but limits cross-split distribution verification.

Brightness augmentation on H&E histology patches may alter staining appearance in ways that do not correspond to real biological variation; verify the brightness range is conservative (non-blocking design note).
The architecture_research analysis field appears truncated (ends mid-sentence with 's...'); the full rationale for channel-statistics-driven design choices may be incomplete in the artefact record.
